question: Who was the first Speaker of the Lok Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**G V Mavalankar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ganesh Vasudev Mavalankar,** who was representing Ahmedabad for the Congress, was chosen **Speaker of the first Lok Sabha on May 15, 1952**, following the first general elections in independent India.
 
• Ganesh Vasudev
